subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers keep the linked Discord media PR as the canonical fix after narrowing its media/SDK contract, or replace it with a fresh current-main branch?
rationale: The bug is real, but the active PR has current-main conflicts and maintainer-visible API/delivery-contract questions that automation should not settle while this issue remains paired with that PR.

options.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
options.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve broader media/SDK surface changes, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrow branch
options.body: Open a fresh maintainer or ClawSweeper replacement that credits the source PR and fixes only the current Discord/media paths needed for this issue.

options.title: Approve the broader media contract
options.body: Accept the public media option and preserved-media cap behavior deliberately, but require documentation, tests, and proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve broader media/SDK surface changes, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across Discord send helpers, shared media loading, and plugin/API boundary work involved in this decision.
